'''Robes of senatorial favor''' were a type of honorary [[Robe/Legends|robe]] intended to showcase an individual's exemplary service to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Two sets of such robes were bestowed upon [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]<ref name="Rogue Planet" /> by [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' places the events of ''[[Rogue Planet]]'' in [[29 BBY/Legends|29 BBY]]. As [[Raith Sienar/Legends|Raith Sienar]] and [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] possess their [[Robe/Legends|robes]] of [[Galactic Senate/Legends|senatorial]] favor during the events of ''Rogue Planet'', the [[Robe/Legends|robes]] must have been created and received by them by 29 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> both recipients wore the [[Clothing/Legends|robes]] while discussing the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation of Planets']] fall from grace in the Republic.<ref name="Rogue Planet" />

==Behind the scenes==
Robes of senatorial favor appeared in the [[2000]] novel ''[[Rogue Planet]]'', written by [[Greg Bear]].<ref name="Rogue Planet" />
